We introduce a novel visual attention grounding model for multimodal machine translation.

1) we introduce a novel multimodality approach that utilizes parallel visual-textual information; 2) our model jointly optimizes a shared visual-language representation and a translator; 3) our model utilizes a visual attention mechanism that links the textual and visual modalities; and 4) our approach achieves competitive stateof-the-art results on several benchmark datasets.
